paragraphs: CRM software means the system of record for who you talk to, what they've bought, and what happens next. Zoho Bigin, HubSpot and Jobber cover most small-business cases — Bigin and HubSpot for a general sales pipeline, Jobber where the work is field-service jobs rather than a sales cycle. We choose based on how your team actually works, configure it, and connect it to your accounting and marketing tools so a lead's status doesn't have to be retyped in three places.

sections.title: Chosen, configured, connected.
items: Platform selection based on your actual sales or job-tracking motion.
Configuration — pipelines, fields, automations that match how deals actually move.
Integration with accounting and marketing tools, so nothing needs retyping.
sections.note: CRM configuration is a named pain point for real estate teams — see [real estate](/industries/real-estate).

items.q: We already have a CRM nobody uses. Can you fix that instead of replacing it?
items.a: Often, yes — a CRM nobody uses is usually a configuration problem, not a platform problem. We'll tell you honestly which one it is before recommending a switch.

items.q: Does this connect to our marketing campaigns?
items.a: Yes, when you're also on a digital marketing plan — leads route into the CRM and trigger follow-up automatically. See digital marketing.

cta.title: Tell us how a lead moves through your business today.
cta.lead: From first contact to closed or booked. We'll tell you where it's getting lost.
